title.text: Which one is easier to test?

runs.text: The discount has to be tested with 50 different amounts. Which version should be tested: the one that changes the box it receives or the one that gives back a new amount?
A pure function is tested with a table of input and output. A subprogram that changes a box forces you to prepare the box, call it and look at it.
The one that gives back a new amount,

justification.text: It is called with each amount and the result is compared, without preparing anything.

runs.text: The one that changes the box,

justification.text: A box has to be prepared before each call and checked afterwards.

runs.text: Both are tested the same way.

justification.text: One needs prepared state; the other does not.
